CA.rationale: No explicit attention/processing condition linked to identified content.

COD.rationale: Content (red coordinates), an organization-like pattern (coordinates), and a separate origin/status field are all explicitly present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition linked to the identified content's presentation/access.

C.rationale: Explicit identification of content (color-labelled coordinate set) for a named referent and time.

D.rationale: A separate origin/status field is attributed to the same identified content referent, distinguishing content identity from its provenance/status.

O.rationale: The coordinate listing presents the content in an explicit organized spatial pattern (grid) bound to the named referent/time.
